meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: Claude 会引导你把 Mattermost 机器人接入 NanoClaw:探测并让你选定服务器、配置 SiteURL、复制适配器代码、创建机器人令牌等,最后跑测试、重启并验证消息与审批卡片能收发。
howto.when: 当你想新增一个 Mattermost 机器人频道(自托管或云端),让 NanoClaw 连上一台 Mattermost 服务器时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个 Mattermost 频道
say.note: 它会先探测本机已有的健康服务器
要带协议,结尾不加斜杠

say.text: 我的 Mattermost 用户名是 alice
say.note: 用来打开你和机器人的私信

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through adding a Mattermost bot channel to NanoClaw: discovering a server, setting SiteURL, copying the adapter, creating a bot token etc., then testing and restarting to verify messages and approval cards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Mattermost bot channel (self-hosted or cloud) and connect NanoClaw to a Mattermost server.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost channel for me
say_en.note: It probes for a healthy local server first

say_en.text: Use https://mm.example.com as the server URL
say_en.note: Include the scheme, no trailing slash
Opens the DM shared with the bot
